notes: IMD Offsets (IMDO) is derived from the MIT-licensed ADAM repository (IMD launch 713). LaunchToken in src/LaunchToken.sol has no constructor arguments; IMDOToken inherits it unchanged and is the alias the manual script uses. Chain selection is external to this manifest: the admission artefact is the Sepolia factory deployment; Ethereum mainnet (1) is the real target, deployed manually from script/DeployImdo.s.sol after this launch (docs/DEPLOYMENT.md). Contracts are in constructor dependency order. ImdoStaking(imdo=$token, imd, manager, claim=$owner, regenSafe=$owner): 5 flat arguments, src/ImdoStaking.sol:79. ImdoTreasury(staking=$contract:ImdoStaking, opsWallet=$owner, offsetsSafe=$owner, regenSafe=$owner, manager, imd, imdFee 10000, imdTickSpacing 200, maxEthPerBuy 1 ETH, slippageBps 300, cooldown 600 s, regenCap 0.5 ETH, regenCapMin 0.05 ETH, regenCapMax 5 ETH): 14 flat arguments, src/ImdoTreasury.sol:109; the IMD leg's no-hook pool key is a constant inside the contract. Because later contracts cannot be referenced, claim, regenSafe, offsetsSafe and opsWallet all resolve to $owner. That address alone can stakeFor any beneficiary, withdraw notified REGEN ETH, set the REGEN cap within 0.05-5 ETH, and receive the operations and retirement splits. These roles are immutable; a later ImdoClaim cannot replace the staking claim caller. The manager and IMD literals have no code on Sepolia, by design: the Treasury constructor skips the pool read when the manager has no code, and process() reverts PoolUnavailable, so this deployment must not be funded and ETH sent to it stays unsplit. The pool fields are this launch's policy values (fee 12500, spacing 60, nominal sqrtPriceX96); the factory opens the pool at the chain's 1.25% fee and derives the opening price from the policy market cap, and the factory pool does not route fees to this treasury. No initialization calls. ImdoHook and ImdoClaim are script-only and not part of this launch; src/RegenDrop.sol and src/regen/* are Base-chain contracts deployed by script/DeployRegenRail.s.sol. Treasury mechanics: anyone may call process() every 600 s for a 50 bps bounty on newly processed ETH; the net is split 1000/2500/2500/4000 bps to operations, ecological-credit retirement, REGEN (capped per 7-day epoch, overflow to the IMD leg) and an IMD buy on the ETH/IMD v4 pool (fee 10000, spacing 200, no hook) pushed to staking as pro-rata IMD rewards. Every stake resets the 24-hour lock; claims pay IMD, never ETH; REGEN withdrawals never exceed what was notified.Imported audit, reproduced at this commit on the unchanged code: (1) medium, src/ImdoStaking.sol:168, stakeFor by the claim role resets any beneficiary's lock, so with claim=$owner that account can keep a staker's principal locked by staking 1 wei daily; the proof fails with StakeLocked as described. Not fixed here: this task may write only launch.json; it is a documented trust assumption of the unfunded admission artefact, and the mainnet path closes it because ImdoClaim stakes only for msg.sender (src/ImdoClaim.sol:128). (2) low, src/ImdoHook.sol:108, the 20% fee stays until open() and renounceOwnership is not overridden; proof fails with 2000 != 150. Script-only contract, outside this manifest; not fixed for the same reason. (3) low, script/DeployImdo.s.sol:176, preflight does not reject holderRoot == 0, which would burn the 10,000,000 IMDO holder tranche; confirmed by reading, outside this manifest, not fixed here. (4) info, docs/REGEN_RAIL.md:51 says 'round-2 audit'; confirmed, copy-only, outside this manifest. The swarm's reviews are checks, not an audit. Known and documented: a sell into the fully emptied single-sided pool fills 1 wei for 0 ETH and moves slot0's tick to the seller's limit until the next buy (cosmetic; a deploy test covers it). Default suite at this commit: 207 passed, 0 failed; test/fork needs an RPC and is excluded by design; forge fmt --check is clean. Any public copy uses 'regenerative contribution'.
